positions.name: RollbackRehearsalCadencePrinciple
positions.frame: what operational principle governs the cadence of Atlas rollback rehearsals?
positions.why: src-1 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals going forward; src-2 supplies the principle behind that directive — an unrehearsed rollback is one you do not actually have. Together they cohere under the question of what principle drives the cadence decision: the mandate and its rationale are the same directional read.
